reviews.t: My daddy always said if it seems to good to be true it usually is!

All I got was lash primer and all the lipsticks were purple and burgundy, eye shadow was yellow and mostly make up brushes with the bristles coming out. So misleading! Amazon has a disclaimer they are not held responsible. Definitely needed for these products! I'm used to great things from Amazon. I'm surprised t

claims.text: Many reviewers report receiving opened, damaged, or broken items, and some feel the packaging was poor.
Several reviewers complain that the products did not match the advertised brands, receiving unknown or off-brand items instead of name brands.
A common complaint is that the colors are random and often unsuitable, such as foundations too dark for the buyer's complexion or overly bright shades.
Many reviewers are happy with their purchase, describing the items as new, clean, good quality, and good value.
Some reviewers note receiving a lot of repetitive or unwanted items like multiple foundations, ChapStick, or tacky jewelry.
